t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The color pairs will appear the same, one will be higher. It changes every 2-3 rounds so check often. I feel like the advice isn't helpful because it didn't make sense to me.

vb_textbox.text: I always chose red, blue, green, and brown. It usually paid off. Choosing purple often lead to 0 points, so I avoided that one. I rarely chose orange or yellow.
